answer.explanation: OrderNotificationService, in the notifications application layer, computes the order discount and payable amount (line 9-10). That is pricing logic whose natural home is the ordering domain, so the rule flags it as a misplaced responsibility. ADR-0003 is Accepted and says this service computes the preview discount for the confirmation e-mail on purpose. It also says the binding discount is computed in the ordering domain at invoicing, and it calls this an accepted exception to keeping pricing rules in the domain layer. The finding is therefore consistent with the declared intent, and the ADR grants this case.

citation.quote: This is an accepted exception to keeping pricing rules in the domain layer.

exceptionClaim.scope: OrderNotificationService computing the preview discount shown in the confirmation e-mail (non-binding estimate); the binding discount stays in the ordering domain.
